upperLimit.source: No UL: ICMR TUL Not found; NASEM 2019 and EFSA set none for food. Reference points only (secondary): NHS 3,700 mg/day supplements unlikely to harm healthy adults; Norway VKM 3,000 mg/day supplemental guidance level; German BfR proposal 500 mg per daily dose. Any potassium medicine needs doctor input

absorptionBlockers: No food blockers; losses from diarrhoea, vomiting, diuretics, laxatives, steroids and high sodium intake lower body potassium

warnings: Potassium from food is tracked as a target to reach (3,510 mg), not a limit, for users with healthy kidneys and no potassium-raising medicines.

Kidney disease, ACE inhibitors, ARBs, potassium-sparing diuretics (spironolactone, eplerenone, amiloride), NSAIDs, pregnancy or breastfeeding: requires_doctor_input; show only the general benchmark plus 'Follow your doctor's advice'; never push more or less potassium.

Never recommend potassium supplements, potassium tablets or potassium-enriched salt substitutes; show salt substitutes only after the user confirms no kidney disease, not pregnant and no potassium-raising medicine, with 'check with your doctor first' (WHO 2025; P3).
Any potassium medicine (tablet, syrup, citrate) is logged as a prescription dose and only when the user marks it as prescribed; never a quick choice.
No ICMR TUL or international UL exists for food potassium; the 3,000 mg supplement reference is secondary.
ICMR potassium values are secondary, unverified; ICMR pregnancy, lactation and 60+ values Not found.
IFCT Prawns, big (S008) row is suspect (sodium 849 mg/100 g); potassium 269 mg/100 g is plausible but use about 141-149 mg/100 g until checked.
Dish files mix 3,500 and 3,510 mg references; use 3,510 mg.
Symptoms of high or low potassium (palpitations, fainting, severe weakness, paralysis, tingling with chest pain): see a doctor now.

conditionAdjustments.change: At least 3,510 mg from food only if no kidney disease and no potassium-raising medicine (ACC/AHA 3,500-5,000); no potassium salt substitutes without a doctor's OK; requires_doctor_input if on ACE inhibitor, ARB or potassium-sparing diuretic
